storage: Airtight jar in a cool dry place; roasted rava keeps about a month (FitPlate dish 6 note). Refrigerate in monsoon to avoid weevils.
looksLike: Cream-coloured, sandy granules, coarser than flour but finer than dalia.
howToPick: Even, dry, creamy-white grains with a clean smell; avoid musty smell, lumps, insects or a yellowish tinge.
shelfLife: About 4 to 6 months in a sealed pack (general guidance; not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 50 g dry rava per serving (about ⅓ cup)
